subject: Pre-training
source_sentence: Pre-training is done using a combination of two language modeling objectives: (1) masked language modeling, where some parts of the input tokens are randomly replaced with a special token (i.e., [MASK]), and the model needs to predict the identity of those tokens and (2) next sentence prediction, where the model is given a sentence pair and trained to classify whether they are two consecutive sentences from a document.
